concept: A broken link as a museum piece, rendered in 3D (Blender). One empty gilt frame with a bone mount and nothing in it, on a plum gallery wall under one track spot, shot along the wall so the frame recedes and bleeds off the left. In focus beside it, the wall label: Untitled (404), Page not found, Still linked from the homepage. Headline: Missing, presumed moved. Plum, gold leaf, bone white.
